subtitle: Out Manila · AirAsia
overview: Fly Manila to Da Nang on an early AirAsia flight (1 piece of 20 kg checked baggage included) and stay three nights in a local 4-star hotel. Day 1 starts with Da Nang Cathedral and Son Tra Peninsula, then Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge. Later days bring a bamboo basket boat and crab fishing at Canaan Island, Hoi An Ancient Town, the Marble Mountains and My Khe Beach. A private coach and an English-speaking guide are included.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Apr 18–21 2027 to Apr 18–21 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Da Nang – Ba Na Hills
items: Meet your tour guide at the airport
Son Tra Peninsula and Linh Ung Pagoda
Transfer to Ba Na Hills and ride the world’s longest single-line cable car, round trip
Walk the Golden Bridge (Buddha hand bridge)
Transfer to hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Canaan Island – Hoi An Ancient Town
items: Transfer to Camnam Island Coconut Village
Ride a round bamboo basket boat and try fun crab fishing (about 1 hour)
Transfer to Hoi An Ancient Town
Visit the Fujian Guild Hall, Cantonese Assembly Hall, Tan Ky Old House and the Japanese Covered Bridge; make a wish with lotus lanterns
Transfer to hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Da Nang city sights
items: Dragon Bridge, Love Bridge and the Dragon head and fish body statue fountain
Marble Mountains, including the upward lift
My Khe Beach, with 1 cup of Vietnamese drip coffee or a specialty drink included
Transfer to hotel and check in

placeDesc.Nguyen Van Thoai Street: A beachside street in Da Nang lined with cafes, restaurants and shops, visited as a city stop.
placeDesc.Linh Ung Pagoda: A Buddhist pagoda on Son Tra Peninsula known for its large white Lady Buddha statue and sea views.
placeDesc.Fantasy Park: The indoor amusement park at Ba Na Hills, with rides and games for visitors.
placeDesc.French Village: A replica French-style hilltop village at Ba Na Hills with pastel buildings, plazas and gardens.
placeDesc.Canaan Island: A river island near Hoi An where the tour takes a round bamboo-basket boat ride.
placeDesc.Camnam Island Coconut Village: A water-coconut village near Hoi An where guests ride a bamboo basket boat and try crab fishing.
placeDesc.Fujian Guild Hall: A colourful assembly hall in Hoi An Old Town built by the Chinese Fujian community.
placeDesc.Cantonese Assembly Hall: A decorated Chinese community hall in Hoi An Old Town, one of the stops on the walking tour.
placeDesc.Tan Ky Old House: A well-preserved merchant house in Hoi An blending Vietnamese, Chinese and Japanese styles.
placeDesc.Japanese Covered Bridge: A small roofed wooden bridge in Hoi An, regarded as the town's best-known landmark.
placeDesc.Love Bridge: A bridge beside Da Nang's Dragon Bridge area, a favourite evening photo stop.
placeDesc.Marble Mountains: A cluster of limestone hills near Da Nang with caves, pagodas and viewpoints; the tour includes the upward lift.
placeDesc.My Khe Beach: A long sandy city beach in Da Nang; the tour includes one Vietnamese drip coffee or specialty drink.
